text:
Sasha: Hey team — quick questions before I start Monday. Two things: 1) When does health/dental coverage actually kick in? 2) I have relocation receipts to submit — what's the process and timeline? Also can I elect an HSA or FSA now, and any W-4 steps I should do first?

Jamie (People Ops): Welcome aboard, Sasha! :tada: High level — benefits and payroll are separate. I can loop folks in. For benefits effective date we usually do the 1st of the month following 30 days of employment (so if you start on Mon it'll usually be the 1st of next month).

Noah (Benefits): Hi Sasha — correct on Jamie's note. You should be able to enroll in medical/dental/vision via the benefits portal within 3 business days of your start access. Coverage effective date: 1st of the month after 30 days. If you need retro coverage due to a gap, let us know and we'll check exceptions.

Noah (Benefits): HSA vs FSA: you can elect either during initial enrollment window. HSA requires choosing our HSA-eligible medical plan. FSA is per-plan and pre-funded per payroll schedule. Link to portal: https://benefits.redwood.example/ (use SSO).

Riley (Payroll): For W-4 — please complete the tax withholding form in the payroll portal before your first pay run. If you don't, we'll apply default federal/state withholding. If you want specific withholding, ping me and I can help.

Sasha: Thanks — for relocation: I got pre-approval from hiring team. Receipts are paper and some digital photos. Do I submit everything to payroll or finance? Any expense code to use?

Riley (Payroll): Put relocation receipts into the expense form and select expense type "Relocation". Submit to finance@redwood.example and CC payroll@redwood.example. We process reimbursements on the next payroll cycle after finance approval (usually next biweekly run). Make sure receipts include date, vendor, and amount.

Riley (Payroll): If you need expedited reimbursement (moving truck same-day cost) add "URGENT - Relocation" in the subject and include your offer approval ID. Finance will triage.

Finance Bot: Received: expense submission queued (ID #84291). Status: awaiting finance approval.

Sasha: Great — and PTO/holidays? If I start mid-month how is vacation accrued and do I get company holidays immediately?

Jamie (People Ops): PTO is pro-rated from your start date. Accrual rate is outlined in the handbook (link in onboarding checklist). Company-observed holidays are front-loaded: you're eligible for observed holidays from day one. Floating holidays follow the policy in the handbook. If you want, I can calculate your pro-rated balance for your start date.

Sasha: Please do that, thanks. Also, is there any paperwork I need to bring on day one besides the usual I-9?

Jamie (People Ops): Bring ID for I-9 or complete remote verification per the checklist. Other forms (W-4, direct deposit, benefits enrollment) are all digital. I'll DM you the onboarding checklist and the PTO pro-rate calc.

Noah (Benefits): One last note — if you're enrolling in HSA, set up external HSA account info in the portal so contributions start on payroll. If you have receipts for expenses already, HSA reimbursements are separate and handled after account setup.

Sasha: Awesome — super helpful. I'll submit receipts now and finish W-4/direct deposit today. Thanks everyone! :heart:
